The nonzero counts sum to 2000 per source class. Source orbit symmetry covers every nonsink vertex. Monotonicity and an explicit all-two recurrent configuration certify sharp 9 versus 24 maxima. The reduced Laplacian eigenanalysis gives 2000 tree states and Poisson equation confirms means 3,4 and sink loss 1.

value.rationale: The stationary joint distribution of avalanche activity and dissipated grains at a specified source is a physically natural, finite exact nonequilibrium observable. The Petersen graph is a canonical smallest non-three-edge-colourable bridgeless cubic network, making the radical change from one-wave maximum 9 to distance-two maximum 24, with a four-size gap 20–23 and exact rare-event count 6, a motivated and useful structural benchmark. Exact finite data are not claimed to imply universal exponents; the fact does not follow from the usual mean-toppling or spanning-tree count.
